Position Title:
Research Scientist I 
 
 Job Group:
Professional & Scientific 
 
 Required Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree 
 
 Job Description:
 Help advance innovative research in functional materials, coatings, and advanced manufacturing at Iowa State University. We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Research Scientist I to support grant-funded research in the Jiang Research Lab . Working closely with the research professor, this position will conduct specialized experiments involving electrohydrodynamic (EHD) printing, ink formulation, materials processing, and characterization of printed and coated materials.
 The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting research activities by operating and maintaining specialized laboratory equipment, troubleshooting technical challenges, coordinating daily laboratory operations, and assisting students and researchers. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to federally funded research projects while supporting the development of innovative materials and advanced manufacturing technologies.
 This is a part-time position working 20 hours per week. 
 This is a term position with an end date of December 31, 2027, with the potential for renewal based on funding availability. 
 
 Main Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Conduct specialized research experiments involving EHD printing, ink formulation, materials processing, surface characterization, and coatings under the guidance of the principal investigator (PI).
 Operate, calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot specialized research equipment, including a custom-built EHD printer, Leica and Keyence microscopes, contact angle goniometer, and other laboratory instruments.
 Prepare experimental setups, configure instruments, perform measurements, and document experimental conditions, instrument settings, and research results to ensure accurate and reproducible data.
 Diagnose technical issues related to printing, imaging, and measurement processes, implement equipment improvements, and maintain operating procedures, calibration records, and maintenance logs.
 Coordinate the installation, commissioning, vendor servicing, and ongoing maintenance of new research instruments supporting federally funded projects.
 Support daily laboratory operations, including experimental scheduling, equipment readiness, inventory management, research documentation, and coordination of laboratory supplies.
 Train and assist graduate students, postdoctoral researchers, and other authorized personnel in equipment operation, sample preparation, experimental procedures, data collection, and basic troubleshooting.
 Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, laboratory safety practices, chemical inventories, waste handling procedures, and equipment-specific safety protocols in accordance with university requirements.
 Collaborate with researchers to adapt experimental procedures, troubleshoot challenges, and support project milestones and research objectives.
 Perform other related technical research and laboratory duties as assigned.


 Preferred Qualifications: 
• PhD degree in materials science and engineering, or closely related field.
 • Experience with laboratory research, materials formulation, coatings, printing, or materials characterization.
 • Experience operating, maintaining, or troubleshooting research instrumentation.
 • Experience with EHD printing, additive manufacturing, functional inks, polymers, nanoparticles.
 • Strong organizational, documentation, the ability to coordinate multiple research activities, and work effectively with students and researchers.

 About the Department: 
The Soft Matter and Nano Research group is part of the Department of Materials Science and Engineering within Iowa State University's College of Engineering. Led by Dr. Shan Jiang, the research group focuses on advancing the understanding and development of soft materials, nanomaterials, functional coatings, and innovative manufacturing technologies. Through interdisciplinary research, advanced laboratory techniques, and collaboration with students and research partners, the group works to develop materials and technologies with real-world applications. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research while supporting scientific discovery and innovation in a collaborative academic environment.
 Learn more about the Department of Materials Science and Engineering 
 


Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis without sponsorship. Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position.

 Application Instructions: 
To apply for this position, please click on “Apply” and complete the Employment Application. Please be prepared to enter or attach the following:
 Resume/Curriculum Vitae
 Letter of Application/Cover Letter
 
 Why Choose Iowa State University? 
Iowa State Employees enjoy comprehensive health and work-life benefits, including medical and dental, as well as:
 Retirement benefits including defined benefit and defined contribution plans
 Generous vacation, holiday, and sick time and leave plans
 Onsite childcare (Ames, Iowa)
 Life insurance and long-term disability
 Flexible Spending Accounts
 Various voluntary benefits and discounts
 Employee Assistance Program
 Wellbeing program
 

 If you have questions regarding this application process, please email employment@iastate.edu, or call 515-294-4800 or Toll Free: 1-877-477-7485.
